ledger.x: 1963: Malaysia is proclaimed (16 September): 'independent Malaya united with the then British crown colonies of North Borneo, Sarawak, and Singapore'.
1963: Singapore joins Malaysia as a state (16 September).
1963: North Borneo joins Malaysia (16 September) and becomes Sabah.

wars.outcome: 'A final peace agreement was signed on 11 August 1966 with Indonesia formally recognising Malaysia.'
